---
title: "Why UK and old Europe have stagnation in productivity growth?"
description: "Structural drag from an ageing workforce and thin R&D investment, compounded by Brexit's hit to trade openness and the energy shock from the Ukraine war."
date: "2023-08-29"
categories: [other, brexit, ukraine]
---

Stagnant productivity growth across the UK and Western Europe reflects both
long-run and cyclical forces: a slowdown in the arrival of major new
technologies, a workforce ageing out of easy retraining, and chronic
underinvestment in R&D. On top of that sit two medium-term shocks — Brexit's
reduction of UK trade openness, and the Ukraine war's disruption of German
energy supply — which the piece identifies as the reason the UK's
productivity slump has been unusually severe, tied specifically to its
reduced access to global value chains.

**Originally published on Substack**, August 29, 2023.
